normalized.description: LOT 1: LAND SURVEYING EQUIPMENT This procurement package is for 6 number survey grade, lightweight and compact Real Time Kinematic (RTK) Global Positioning Systems (GPS) Receiver units for various satellite positioning tasks in Land Surveying, Civil Engineering and Construction applications and each unit to consist of a dual frequency GNSS Receiver, Controller, with Surveying and Setting out Software, Pole, Brackets, Chargers and an Educational Network License valid for a five-year period.
